transcript: Speaker A: This is what my day sounded like before using Wispr. Emails, Slack, text, type, delete, rewrite, all day. Now this is what it sounds like. Hi, I just wanted to follow up about our conversation earlier. I didn't even realize how much I was using it until I checked. According to this, I have completed one book. I didn't realize how much typing was slowing me down until I stopped doing it. Now I just say what I need to say and then move on. Download Wispr Flow and try it for free, you'll see what I mean.
